sections.title: Grammar — prepositions with the cat and the basket

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to the correct prepositions, then make sentences as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni to'g'ri predloglarga moslang, so'ng namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Oltita rasm — bitta mushuk va bitta savat, oltita xil holat.
Bu — predloglarni o'rganishning ENG YAXSHI usuli: narsalar
bir xil, faqat JOY o'zgaradi.

Predloglar: behind, in, on, under, in front of, near

Namuna: 1  The cat is near the basket.

QOLIP: The cat is + PREDLOG + the basket.

answers.descEn: Picture 1 — the cat is standing beside the basket, not touching it
Picture 2 — the cat is standing in front of the basket, the basket is behind it
answers.descUz: 2-rasm: mushuk savatning oldida turibdi, savat uning orqasida

answers.descEn: Picture 3 — the cat is sitting inside the basket
Picture 4 — the cat is standing on top of the basket
Picture 5 — only the cat's tail and head are visible behind the basket
answers.descUz: 5-rasm: savat orqasidan mushukning faqat dumi va boshi ko'rinadi

answers.descEn: Picture 6 — the basket is upside down and the cat is underneath it

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna: The cat is near the basket.

QOLIP: The cat IS + predlog + THE basket.
Har bir gapda 'the' ikki marta keladi — 'the cat' va 'the basket'.

example.en: The cat is near the basket.

modelSentences.sentence: The cat is in front of the basket.
The cat is in the basket.
The cat is on the basket.
The cat is behind the basket.
The cat is under the basket.

exercises.explanationUz:
YASHASH JOYI PREDLOGLARI — eng chalkash mavzu.

  IN  — ichida bo'lgan joy:
        in a flat, in a house, in a village, in London,
        in Kent, in the attic, in the garden, in the area,
        in Marble Street (ko'cha nomi, raqamsiz)

  ON  — yuza yoki maydon:
        on the fourth floor, on a farm, on a houseboat,
        on the River Thames

  AT  — aniq nuqta, uy raqami bilan:
        at 25, Momon Street

QO'SHIMCHA PREDLOGLAR:
  FROM — masofa:  half a mile FROM the city centre
  NEAR — yaqinlik: near the shops
  FOR  — maqsad:   for sale (sotuvga qo'yilgan)
  OF   — material: made OF wood

ESLAB QOLING — ko'cha bilan:
  AT 25, Momon Street  (uy raqami bor)
  IN Marble Street     (uy raqami yo'q)

items.textEn: 1  I live ____ a small flat ____ the fourth floor. (1-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: Kvartira ichida yashaydi → IN a flat.

items.textEn: 1  I live in a small flat ____ the fourth floor. (2-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: Qavat uchun doim ON: on the fourth floor.

items.textEn: 2  Tom lives ____ a farm ____ Kent. (1-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: Ferma — yer maydoni → ON a farm.

items.textEn: 2  Tom lives on a farm ____ Kent. (2-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: Kent — Angliyaning bir grafligi (hudud) → IN Kent.

items.textEn: 3  She lives ____ 25, Momon Street.
items.whyUz: Uy RAQAMI bor — aniq nuqta → AT.

items.textEn: 4  His flat is ____ Marble Street.
items.whyUz: Uy raqami YO'Q, faqat ko'cha nomi → IN Marble Street.

items.textEn: 5  They live ____ London.
items.whyUz: Shahar → IN.

items.textEn: 6  Jason lives half a mile ____ the city centre.
items.whyUz: Masofa uchun FROM: 'yarim mil markazDAN'.

items.textEn: 7  Her house is ____ the shops.
items.whyUz: Yaqinlik uchun NEAR. 'near from' EMAS — faqat 'near'.

items.textEn: 8  Is there a supermarket ____ the area?
items.whyUz: Hudud → IN the area.

items.textEn: 9  There is a swimming-pool ____ the garden.
items.whyUz: Bog' — chegarasi bor joy → IN the garden.

items.textEn: 10  She lives ____ a village.
items.whyUz: Qishloq → IN a village.

items.textEn: 11  We live ____ a houseboat.
items.whyUz: Qayiq USTIDA → ON a houseboat. Barcha qayiq va kemalar uchun ON.

items.textEn: 12  The houseboat is ____ the River Thames.
items.whyUz: Daryo YUZASIDA → ON the river. Temza — Londondagi daryo.

items.textEn: 13  That house is ____ sale.
items.whyUz: 'for sale' — sotiladi. Turg'un birikma, o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 14  There is a study ____ the attic.
items.whyUz: Chordoq ichida → IN the attic.

items.textEn: 15  Chalets are made ____ wood.
items.whyUz: 'made of' — ...dan yasalgan. Materialni bildiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an, some or any.
exercises.instructionUz: a, an, some yoki any so'zini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL:
  1) Ot BIRLIKMI yoki KO'PLIKMI?
  2) Gap TASDIQMI yoki INKOR/SAVOLMI?

  BIRLIK → a (undosh tovush) yoki an (unli tovush)
  KO'PLIK + tasdiq → some
  KO'PLIK + inkor/savol → any

DIQQAT: birlik otda inkor va savol bo'lsa ham 'any' EMAS:
  ✅ Is there A park near here?
  ✅ There isn't A bathroom upstairs.

items.textEn: 1  There are ____ flowers in the vase.
items.whyUz: 'flowers' ko'plik, tasdiq → some.

items.textEn: 2  Are there ____ shops near your house?
items.whyUz: 'shops' ko'plik, savol → any.

items.textEn: 3  Is there ____ park near here?
items.whyUz: 'park' BIRLIK — savol bo'lsa ham 'any' emas. /p/ undosh → a.

items.textEn: 4  There isn't ____ bathroom upstairs.
items.whyUz: 'bathroom' birlik — inkor bo'lsa ham 'a'. /b/ undosh.

items.textEn: 5  There aren't ____ chairs in the kitchen.
items.whyUz: 'chairs' ko'plik, inkor → any.

items.textEn: 6  Are there ____ good restaurants near here?
items.whyUz: 'restaurants' ko'plik, savol → any. Sifat ('good') bo'lsa ham qoida o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 7  There's ____ armchair in the living-room.
items.whyUz: 'armchair' /ɑː/ unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an.

items.textEn: 8  There are ____ cushions on the sofa.
items.whyUz: 'cushions' ko'plik, tasdiq → some.

items.textEn: 9  Are there ____ books on the desk?
items.whyUz: 'books' ko'plik, savol → any.

items.textEn: 10  There aren't ____ towels in the bathroom.
items.whyUz: 'towels' ko'plik, inkor → any.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and fill in the correct prepositions.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va to'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ishlatiladigan predloglar: on, in, under, behind, near, in front of

RASMDA: mehmonxona. Chap tomonda katta yog'och shkaf,
yonida kreslo va chiroqli stol, o'ng tomonda uzun divan,
divan orqasida katta deraza va pardalar,
divan oldida past jurnal stoli (ustida kitoblar va idish),
stol ostida naqshli gilam.

MASHQ SIRI: har bir gapda IKKI narsa taqqoslanadi.
Birinchisi qayerda — ikkinchisiga NISBATAN aytiladi.

items.textEn: 1  There is a rug ____ the table.
items.whyUz: Gilam past stolning OSTIDA, polda yotibdi.

items.textEn: 2  There is an armchair ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Kreslo divanga YAQIN, chap tomonda. Ro'yxatda 'next to' yo'q — 'near' ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 3  There are some cushions ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Yostiqchalar divan USTIDA.

items.textEn: 4  There is a table ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Jurnal stoli divanning OLDIDA turibdi.

items.textEn: 5  There are some books ____ the table.
items.whyUz: Kitoblar stol USTIDA yotibdi.

items.textEn: 6  There are some armchairs ____ the room.
items.whyUz: Xona uchun doim IN the room.

items.textEn: 7  There is a big window ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Deraza divanning ORQASIDA — divan derazaga tirab qo'yilgan.

items.textEn: 8  There is a lamp ____ the table next to the sofa.
items.whyUz: Chiroq stol USTIDA turibdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers as in the example. Use the prepositions in, on and at.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek savol va javob yozing. in, on va at predloglaridan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  John?/school → Where's John? He's at school.

UCH PREDLOG:
  AT — muassasa yoki tadbir: at school, at work, at home,
       at the cinema, at a party
  IN — ichida: in my bag, in the garden, in the room
  ON — yuzada: on the table, on the wall, on the floor

'AT SCHOOL' — 'maktabDA' (o'qish uchun). Binoning ichida
ekanini ta'kidlash kerak bo'lsa 'in the school' deyiladi,
lekin odatda 'at school'.

Javob shakli:
  erkak → He's,  ayol → She's
  narsa → It's,  ko'plik → They're

items.question: Where's John?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. John — erkak → He's. Maktab uchun AT.

items.question: Where's my bag?
items.whyUz: Sumka — narsa → It's. Stol YUZASIDA → on the table.

items.question: Where are your books?
items.whyUz: 'books' ko'plik → Where ARE ... THEY'RE. Sumka ICHIDA → in my bag.

items.question: Where are the boys?
items.whyUz: 'boys' ko'plik → Where are ... They're. Bog' ichida → in the garden.

groups.explanationUz: Bu birikmalarda predlog HECH QACHON almashmaydi — butun holda yodlanadi.

items.note: made FROM ham bor — material o'zgargan bo'lsa

groups.explanationUz: Uy raqami borligiga qarab predlog o'zgaradi.
Ikkalasi ham 'qanchalik uzoq' haqida, lekin tuzilishi boshqa.

items.derived: half a mile FROM the centre

groups.explanationUz: Qayiq, kema va daryo bilan doim ON ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: The cat is + predlog + the basket.
patterns.exampleEn: The cat is near the basket. The cat is in the basket.
patterns.exampleUz: Mushuk savat yonida. Mushuk savat ichida.
patterns.explanationUz:
Eng sodda predlog qolipi. Narsalar bir xil, faqat predlog o'zgaradi —
shuning uchun farqni yaxshi sezasiz.

patterns.exampleEn: I live in a small flat on the fourth floor. She lives at 25, Momon Street.
patterns.exampleUz: Men to'rtinchi qavatdagi kichik kvartirada yashayman. U Momon ko'chasi, 25-uyda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda ikki predlog ham bo'lishi mumkin: IN (kvartira) + ON (qavat).

patterns.formula: There is/are + a/an/some/any + ot + predlog + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a rug under the table. There are some books on the table.
patterns.exampleUz: Stol ostida gilamcha bor. Stol ustida kitoblar bor.
patterns.explanationUz: To'liq qolip: fe'l + aniqlovchi + ot + predlog + joy.

patterns.exampleEn: Where's John? — He's at school. Where are your books? — They're in my bag.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon qayerda? — U maktabda. Kitoblaring qayerda? — Ular sumkamda.
patterns.explanationUz: Egalik olmoshi bilan 'the' ishlatilmaydi: 'in MY bag' (in the my bag EMAS).
Ko'plik ega bilan 'are made of'. Birlik bilan 'is made of'.
